iOS.description:
Pick a number. Outsmart your rival.

Choose a number from the highlighted row or column, take its points, and set your rival’s next line. Think ahead and finish with the higher score.

Practice against 18 named computer rivals. Choose a board from 4 × 4 to 14 × 14 and find the challenge that suits you.

Keep several local games ready to continue, customize your players, replay a computer move, and search your saved games. Finished games can share their real move history as a GIF, or share the final board when an older save has no move history.

Optional Game Center races use Apple’s two-player turn-based matchmaker and require Game Center sign-in and internet. The Messages extension prepares a 4 × 4 board bubble for a conversation with one friend; you choose when to send it.

The Apple Watch edition runs solo 4 × 4 games independently. Its optional friend-game inbox uses a paired iPhone and Game Center. Local progress stays on each device.

No ads or in-app purchases. Solo and local two-player games work offline.
iOS.whatsNew: A refreshed living garden, 18 computer rivals, customizable players, replay, searchable saved games, and adaptive layouts for iPhone Duo.
iOS.reviewNotes: Version 2.3 build 2026111803. Solo and pass-and-play require no app account or internet. Optional friend games use the system Game Center account. The Messages extension prepares a 4 × 4 game bubble; the user taps Send. Watch friend games use the paired iPhone. Two-account Game Center delivery and physical-device comfort have not been verified.
iOS.promotionalText: One number. So many possibilities. Take the points, shape the next turn, and find your next challenge.

tvOS.description:
Pick a number. Outsmart your rival.

Choose a number from the highlighted row or column, take its points, and set your rival’s next line. Think ahead and finish with the higher score.

Practice against 18 named computer rivals. Choose a board from 4 × 4 to 14 × 14 and find the challenge that suits you.

Bring the tangle to the big screen. Use your Apple TV remote to choose legal numbers, play against the computer, or take turns with a friend in the same room.

Continue saved local progress and review the moves in a replay. Choose the next game’s board size and rival from player options.

The Apple TV edition supports local play. It does not include Game Center races, Messages games, or progress syncing between devices.

No ads or in-app purchases. Solo and local two-player games work offline.
tvOS.whatsNew: Tally Tangle arrives on Apple TV with remote-focused number strategy, 18 computer rivals, local two-player games, saved progress, and replay.
tvOS.reviewNotes: Version 2.3 build 2026111802. Native tvOS app. Use Play for a solo game. Player options enable Pass & Play, choose one of 18 rivals, and select a 4 × 4 to 14 × 14 board. Focus a highlighted legal number and select it. Back opens the leave confirmation during play; at home, Back returns to the system. Replay pauses live computer turns. Local play requires no account or internet. This edition does not offer Game Center or Messages.
